name: 19" 1U rack mount for 1-3 slim NUCs
notes: 1U, three bays for slim (K) 4 x 4 in NUCs: NUC 7 to NUC 15 Pro. Three blanked openings on the front for optional LAN, USB, USB-C, HDMI, DisplayPort or audio feed-through inserts; blank covers for empty bays sold separately. Add each NUC as its own device.

name: 19" 1.5U rack mount for 1-3 tall NUCs
notes: 1.5U (shown as 2RU), three bays for tall (H) 4 x 4 in NUCs: NUC 8 to NUC 15 Pro. Three blanked openings on the front for optional connector inserts. Add each NUC as its own device.

name: 19" 3U rack for 1-8 NUCs (expandable to 12)
notes: 3U, 8 mounting plates for tall (H) NUCs, or up to 12 slim (K) NUCs with 4 extra plates; tall and slim can be mixed. NUC 10 to NUC 13 Pro, NUC 14 and NUC 15 Pro (not NUC 15 Pro+). Optional front LAN, USB 3.0 and HDMI inserts. Add each NUC as its own device.

name: 19" 1U rack mount for 1-3 NUC Essential, Pro or Pro+
notes: 1U, three bays for ASUS NUC Essential, Pro and Pro+ units. Add each NUC as its own device. Check: article number and which heights fit.
